blocking_findings.summary: A caller-declared qualification_registry_root can downgrade a PRODUCTION authority, move the one-shot reservation and terminal sinks to caller-selected roots, and permit repeated real checkpoint and numerical consumption for one package identity.

unresolved_findings.summary: The live claim_terminal_sinks boundary that carries the loop 7 repair has no direct generated DAG edge or mechanical test.

advisory_findings: ValidatedBridgeExecutionResult is shallow-frozen and permits nested mutation outside the supported producer path.
bank_terminal does not independently revalidate its payload against the sealed sink.
the qualification-root overlap guard rejects equality and descendants but not ancestor roots.
authority_mode threading into V11 wrappers is inert on the V1 production path.
